# E0623: the directory for a new lineage already holds version files

`thema lineage init` creates a new lineage, and never overwrites one: the
directory it would write the new lineage's tip.thema in already holds version
files, here the tip and history of the lineage ship.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0623]: ship already holds a lineage's version files
  |
  = help: init creates a new lineage and never overwrites one: give -l a directory that holds no version files
```
